# One-way repeated measures: a single within-subject factor (Day). The report
# renders the ANOVA summary and one detailed results table for the Day factor.
if (!is.null(params$anova_table)) {
   df1 <- data.frame(params$table)
  anova_table <- data.frame(params$anova_table)

  # Render for HTML
  if (knitr::is_html_output()) {

    #ANOVA TABLE
     crdp_html_ANOVA<-anova_table %>%
        kableExtra::kbl(caption = "ANOVA summary table",
                        align = "c", escape = FALSE) %>%
        kableExtra::kable_styling(
          bootstrap_options = "bordered",
          full_width = FALSE,
          latex_options = "booktabs"
        ) %>%
        kableExtra::kable_classic(full_width = F)%>%
      kableExtra::footnote(number = c("SoV= Source of Variation",
                                        "DF = Degrees of Freedom",
                                        "Mean squares is provided for each character",
                                        "* indicates significance at 5% level",
                                        "** indicates significance at 1% level",
                                        "NS indicates non-significant")
        )
    cat(crdp_html_ANOVA)

    # Mauchly's Test of Sphericity. In the report the verdict is shown as
    # coloured words (Assumed / Violated), not the tick / cross icons.
    if (is.data.frame(params$mauchly) && nrow(params$mauchly) > 0) {
      mauchly_df <- data.frame(params$mauchly, check.names = FALSE)
      mauchly_df[] <- lapply(mauchly_df, function(x) {
        x <- gsub("Violated", "<span style='color:#c62828;font-weight:bold;'>Violated</span>", x)
        x <- gsub("Assumed",  "<span style='color:#2e7d32;font-weight:bold;'>Assumed</span>", x)
        x
      })
      crdp_html_mauchly <- mauchly_df %>%
        kableExtra::kbl(caption = "Table 2: Mauchly's Test of Sphericity (within-subject effect)",
                        align = "c", escape = FALSE) %>%
        kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "bordered", full_width = FALSE,
                                  latex_options = "booktabs") %>%
        kableExtra::kable_classic(full_width = F) %>%
        kableExtra::footnote(number = c(
          "Mauchly's W tests the sphericity assumption for the repeated (within-subject) factor.",
          "'Violated' means p is below the significance level; 'Assumed' means it is not.",
          "When sphericity is violated, the within-subject F-test is adjusted using the selected correction (Greenhouse-Geisser / Huynh-Feldt).",
          "Sphericity is automatic (no test) when the repeated factor has only two levels."))
      cat(crdp_html_mauchly)
      if (isTRUE(params$mauchly_violated)) {
        cat(paste0("<div style='margin-top:10px; padding:10px 14px; background-color:#fff3cd; border-left:5px solid #e0a800; border-radius:5px; font-size:13px; color:#5c4500;'>",
                   "<b>Sphericity correction needed.</b> One or more characters violate the sphericity assumption. ",
                   "A correction (Greenhouse-Geisser or Huynh-Feldt) should be applied to the within-subject F-test. ",
                   "Correction selected for this analysis: <b>", params$correction, "</b>.</div>"))
      } else {
        cat(paste0("<div style='margin-top:10px; padding:10px 14px; background-color:#d4edda; border-left:5px solid #28a745; border-radius:5px; font-size:13px; color:#155724;'>",
                   "<b>Sphericity holds.</b> All characters meet the sphericity assumption, so no correction is required. ",
                   "Correction selected: <b>", params$correction, "</b>.</div>"))
      }
    }

    # Main table (Day - the single within-subject factor)
    df1[] <- lapply(df1, function(x) {
  gsub("&plusmn;", " $\\pm$ ", x, fixed = TRUE)
})

    crdp_html_table1<-df1 %>%
        kableExtra::kbl(caption = "Detailed tabular representation with letter grouping and other important statistics of Day", align = "c", escape = FALSE) %>%
        kableExtra::kable_styling(
          bootstrap_options = "bordered",
          full_width = FALSE,
          latex_options = "booktabs"
        ) %>%
        kableExtra::kable_classic(full_width = F)%>%

        kableExtra::footnote(number = c("Cell values are mean \u00B1 SD",
                                        "Parenthesised means follow the selected scale ; ",
                                        "Days with same letter grouping are not significantly different",
                                        "* indicates significance at 5% level",
                                        "** indicates significance at 1% level",
                                        "NS indicates non-significant",
                                        "MSE and CV(%) are common for this experiment"

        )
        )
    cat(crdp_html_table1)

    }
###########################################################html close



####################################################### Render for PDF
  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {

  ### ANOVA TABLE
   # Replace HTML elements with LaTeX equivalents
    anova_table[] <- lapply(anova_table, function(x) {
      gsub("<sup>", "$\\\\textsuperscript{", gsub("</sup>", "}$", x))
    })
# Replace ± with \pm in LaTeX
anova_table[] <- lapply(anova_table, function(x) {
  gsub("<sup>", "$\\\\pm$", x)
})
anova_table[] <- lapply(anova_table, function(x) {
  gsub("%", "\\\\%", x)
})

colnames(anova_table) <- gsub("%", "\\\\Perc", colnames(anova_table))
colnames(anova_table) <- gsub("_", ".", colnames(anova_table))
rownames(anova_table) <- gsub("%", "\\\\Perc", rownames(anova_table))
rownames(anova_table) <- gsub("_", ".", rownames(anova_table))
  crdp_pdf_ANOVA<- anova_table %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(
    caption = "ANOVA summary table",
    format = "latex",
    escape = FALSE,
    align = "l",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    # longtable = TRUE,
    linesep = "",
    ) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
      position = "center",
      latex_options = c("striped", "repeat_header","scale_down", "H"),
      full_width = F
    )%>%
kableExtra::footnote(number = c("SoV= Source of Variation",
                                        "DF = Degrees of Freedom",
                                        "Mean squares is provided for each character",
                                        "* indicates significance at 5% level",
                                        "** indicates significance at 1% level",
                                        "NS indicates non-significant")
        )
print(crdp_pdf_ANOVA)

# Mauchly's Test of Sphericity
    if (is.data.frame(params$mauchly) && nrow(params$mauchly) > 0) {
      mauchly_df <- data.frame(params$mauchly, check.names = FALSE)
      # "<" is special in LaTeX text mode; wrap so "<0.001" renders correctly.
      mauchly_df[] <- lapply(mauchly_df, function(x) gsub("<", "$<$", x, fixed = TRUE))
      # Colour the verdicts to match the app (green = Assumed, red = Violated).
      mauchly_df[] <- lapply(mauchly_df, function(x) {
        x <- gsub("Violated", "\\\\textcolor{red}{\\\\textbf{Violated}}", x)
        x <- gsub("Assumed",  "\\\\textcolor{green}{\\\\textbf{Assumed}}", x)
        x
      })
      colnames(mauchly_df) <- gsub("_", ".", colnames(mauchly_df))
      rownames(mauchly_df) <- gsub("_", ".", rownames(mauchly_df))
      crdp_pdf_mauchly <- mauchly_df %>%
        kableExtra::kbl(caption = "Mauchly's Test of Sphericity (within-subject effect)",
                        format = "latex", escape = FALSE, align = "l",
                        booktabs = TRUE, linesep = "") %>%
        kableExtra::kable_styling(position = "center",
                                  latex_options = c("striped", "repeat_header", "scale_down", "H"),
                                  full_width = F) %>%
        kableExtra::footnote(number = c(
          "Mauchly's W tests the sphericity assumption for the repeated (within-subject) factor.",
          "'Violated' means p is below the significance level; 'Assumed' means it is not.",
          "When sphericity is violated, the within-subject F-test is adjusted using the selected correction.",
          "Sphericity is automatic (no test) when the repeated factor has only two levels."))
      print(crdp_pdf_mauchly)
      if (isTRUE(params$mauchly_violated)) {
        cat("\n\n\\textbf{Sphericity correction needed.} One or more characters violate the sphericity assumption; a correction (Greenhouse-Geisser or Huynh-Feldt) should be applied to the within-subject F-test. Correction selected for this analysis: ",
            params$correction, ".\n\n", sep = "")
      } else {
        cat("\n\n\\textbf{Sphericity holds.} All characters meet the sphericity assumption, so no correction is required. Correction selected: ",
            params$correction, ".\n\n", sep = "")
      }
    }

# ################################# Day (single within-subject factor)
df1[] <- lapply(df1, function(x) {
   gsub("<sup>", "$\\\\textsuperscript{", gsub("</sup>", "}$", x))
})

df1[] <- lapply(df1, function(x) {
   gsub("<br>|</br>", " \\\\ ", x)  # Replaces <br> and </br> with LaTeX line breaks
})

# Replace ± with \pm in LaTeX
df1[] <- lapply(df1, function(x) {
   gsub("&plusmn;", "$\\\\pm$", x)
})

df1[] <- lapply(df1, function(x) {
   gsub("%", "\\\\%", x)
})

colnames(df1) <- gsub("%", "\\\\Perc", colnames(df1))
colnames(df1) <- gsub("_", ".", colnames(df1))
rownames(df1) <- gsub("%", "\\\\Perc", rownames(df1))
rownames(df1) <- gsub("_", ".", rownames(df1))

crdp_pdf_table1A <- df1 %>%
  kableExtra::kbl(
    caption = "Detailed tabular representation with Multiple comparisons for Day",
    format = "latex",
    escape = FALSE,
    align = "l",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    # longtable = TRUE,
    linesep = ""
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    position = "center",
    latex_options = c("striped", "repeat_header","scale_down", "H"),
    full_width = F
  )%>%
kableExtra::footnote(number = c("Cell values are mean \u00B1 SD",
                                "Parenthesised means follow the selected scale ; ",
                                "Letter grouping is given based on SE(d) DF ",
                                "Days with same letter grouping are not significantly different",
                                "* indicates significance at 5% level",
                                "** indicates significance at 1% level",
                                "NS indicates non-significant",
                                "MSE and CV(%) are common for this experiment")
        )


print(crdp_pdf_table1A)

}

  #### function to replace scripts
replace_superscripts <- function(text) {
  # Replace non-empty <sup> tags with the corresponding superscript format
  # replace ,<sup>**</sup> with **
  text <- gsub("<sup>\\*\\*</sup>", "**", text)
  text <- gsub("<sup>\\*</sup>", "*", text)
  # Trim any spaces inside the tag so pandoc renders ^a^ (a real superscript)
  # instead of printing a literal ^ a ^ (pandoc only superscripts when there
  # is no space between the carets).
  text <- gsub("<sup>[[:space:]]*([^<]*[^[:space:]<])[[:space:]]*</sup>", "^\\1^", text)
  # Remove empty or whitespace-only <sup> tags
  text <- gsub("<sup>\\s*</sup>", "", text)
  # remove ^ from **

  text
}

   # Render for Word
  if (knitr::pandoc_to("docx")) {


    #ANOVA TABLE
  anova_table[] <- lapply(anova_table, replace_superscripts)
  crdp_word_ANOVA<-anova_table %>%
 kable(caption = "Table 1: ANOVA summary table",align='c', row.names = TRUE, escape = FALSE, format = "pandoc")
 print(crdp_word_ANOVA)

   cat("\n\nSoV = Source of Variation, DF = Degrees of Freedom; Mean squares are provided for each character; * indicates significance at 5% level, ** indicates significance at 1% level, NS indicates non-significance.\n\n")

   ## Mauchly's Test of Sphericity
 if (is.data.frame(params$mauchly) && nrow(params$mauchly) > 0 && ncol(params$mauchly) > 0) {
   # Build a flextable so Word shows the coloured Assumed / Violated verdicts like the app.
   mres <- params$mauchly
   mdf  <- data.frame(Statistic = rownames(mres), mres, check.names = FALSE,
                      row.names = NULL, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
   ft <- flextable::flextable(mdf)
   ft <- flextable::set_caption(ft, "Table 2: Mauchly's Test of Sphericity (within-subject effect)")
   # flextable defaults to Arial and does NOT read styles.docx, so it looked
   # different from the kable/pandoc tables. Match the report body font
   # (styles.docx theme font: Times New Roman, 11pt).
   ft <- flextable::font(ft, fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all")
   ft <- flextable::fontsize(ft, size = 11, part = "all")
   ft <- flextable::bold(ft, part = "header")
   for (rr in seq_len(nrow(mdf))) {
     for (cc in seq_len(ncol(mdf))[-1]) {
       v <- mdf[rr, cc]
       if (identical(v, "Violated")) {
         ft <- flextable::color(ft, i = rr, j = cc, color = "#c62828")
         ft <- flextable::bold(ft, i = rr, j = cc)
       } else if (identical(v, "Assumed")) {
         ft <- flextable::color(ft, i = rr, j = cc, color = "#2e7d32")
         ft <- flextable::bold(ft, i = rr, j = cc)
       }
     }
   }
   ft <- flextable::border_outer(ft, part = "all")
   ft <- flextable::border_inner(ft, part = "all")
   ft <- flextable::align(ft, j = seq(2, ncol(mdf)), align = "center", part = "all")
   ft <- flextable::autofit(ft)
   cat(flextable::flextable_to_rmd(ft))
   if (isTRUE(params$mauchly_violated)) {
     cat("\n\n**Sphericity correction needed.** One or more characters violate the sphericity assumption; a correction (Greenhouse-Geisser or Huynh-Feldt) should be applied to the within-subject F-test. Correction selected for this analysis: ",
         params$correction, ".\n\n", sep = "")
   } else {
     cat("\n\n**Sphericity holds.** All characters meet the sphericity assumption, so no correction is required. Correction selected: ",
         params$correction, ".\n\n", sep = "")
   }
   cat("\n\nMauchly's W tests the sphericity assumption for the repeated (within-subject) factor; 'Violated' means p is below the significance level; sphericity is automatic (no test) when the repeated factor has only two levels.\n\n")
 }
